title: Hearing on Parks Department's work with volunteers and community groups
summary: The Council's Committee on Parks and Recreation will examine how the Department of Parks and Recreation engages community-based organizations and volunteers who help maintain the city's parks. The hearing covers programs like Partnerships for Parks and City Parks Foundation, and notes volunteer turnout fell to 38,845 in fiscal year 2025 from 39,186 in fiscal year 2024. The committee will also consider a separate bill co-naming two streets after soccer stars Thierry Henry and Pelé.
